newsitem.title: USA: Welsh Carson closes $1.3 bln healthcare/tech LP.
newsitem.headline: Welsh Carson closes $1.3 bln healthcare/tech LP.

text.p: Welsh, Carson, Anderson & Stowe said Thursday that it has successfully completed the offering of a $1.3 billion limited partnership which will purchase subordinated debt with equity interests in companies in the healthcare and information services industries in which another Welsh Carson partnership is the controlling shareholder.
The new partnership, WCAS Capital Partners III LP, is the tenth institutionally funded partnership formed by the firm over the past 18 years.
With aggregate capital of $4.7 billion, the firm said it is one of the largest sources of private equity in the country and the major provider of capital to its two industries of interest.
